candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, it only sets the new password and updates the user. It never invalidates existing sessions (e.g. sessionService.deleteByUserId), so sessions on other devices stay valid and their refresh tokens keep working through refreshToken, which only checks the session hash.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after the password update succeeds, delete all of the user's sessions (for example, await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id })). Add that method to the session service if it is missing. That makes every refresh token invalid and signs out all devices.
